verses.en: Afterward he brought me again unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward: for the forefront of the house stood toward the east, and the waters came down from under from the right side of the house, at the south side of the altar.
verses.pt: Depois disso me fez voltar à entrada do templo; e eis que saíam umas águas por debaixo do limiar do templo, para o oriente; pois a frente do templo dava para o oriente; e as águas desciam pelo lado meridional do templo ao sul do altar.
verses.en_web: He brought me back to the door of the house; and behold, waters flowed out from under the threshold of the house eastward, for the front of the house faced toward the east. The waters came down from underneath, from the right side of the house, on the south of the altar.
verses.en_bbe: And he took me back to the door of the house; and I saw that waters were flowing out from under the doorstep of the house on the east, for the house was facing east: and the waters came down from under, from the right side of the house, on the south side of the altar.

verses.en: Then brought he me out of the way of the gate northward, and led me about the way without unto the utter gate by the way that looketh eastward; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.
verses.pt: Então me levou para fora pelo caminho da porta do norte, e me fez dar uma volta pelo caminho de fora até a porta exterior, pelo caminho da porta oriental; e eis que corriam umas águas pelo lado meridional.
verses.en_web: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me around by the way outside to the outer gate, by the way of the gate that looks toward the east. Behold, waters ran out on the right side.
verses.en_bbe: And he took me out by the north doorway, and made me go round to the outside of the doorway looking to the east; and I saw waters running slowly out on the south side.

verses.en: And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters were to the ancles.
verses.pt: Saindo o homem para o oriente, tendo na mão um cordel de medir, mediu mil côvados, e me fez passar pelas águas, águas que me davam pelos artelhos.
verses.en_web: When the man went out eastward with the line in his hand, he measured one thousand cubits, and he caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the ankles.
verses.en_bbe: And the man went out to the east with the line in his hand, and after measuring a thousand cubits, he made me go through the waters, which came over my feet.

verses.en: Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters were to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through; the waters were to the loins.
verses.pt: De novo mediu mil, e me fez passar pelas águas, águas que me davam pelos joelhos; outra vez mediu mil, e me fez passar pelas águas, águas que me davam pelos lombos.
verses.en_web: Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the knees. Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through waters that were to the waist.
verses.en_bbe: And again, measuring a thousand cubits, he made me go through the waters which came up to my knees. Again, measuring a thousand, he made me go through the waters up to the middle of my body.

verses.en: Afterward he measured a thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.
verses.pt: Ainda mediu mais mil, e era um rio, que eu não podia atravessar; pois as águas tinham crescido, águas para nelas nadar, um rio pelo qual não se podia passar a vau.
verses.en_web: Afterward he measured one thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass through; for the waters had risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be walked through.
verses.en_bbe: Again, after his measuring a thousand, it became a river which it was not possible to go through: for the waters had become deep enough for swimming, a river it was not possible to go through.

verses.en: And he said unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen this? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the brink of the river.
verses.pt: E me perguntou: Viste, filho do homem? Então me levou, e me fez voltar à margem do rio.
verses.en_web: He said to me, “Son of man, have you seen?” Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the bank of the river.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to me, Son of man, have you seen this? Then he took me to the river's edge.

verses.en: Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.
verses.pt: Tendo eu voltado, eis que à margem do rio havia árvores em grande número, de uma e de outra banda.
verses.en_web: Now when I had returned, behold, on the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.
verses.en_bbe: And he took me back, and I saw at the edge of the river a very great number of trees on this side and on that.

verses.en: Then said he unto me, These waters issue out toward the east country, and go down into the desert, and go into the sea: which being brought forth into the sea, the waters shall be healed.
verses.pt: Então me disse: Estas águas saem para a região oriental e, descendo pela Arabá, entrarão no Mar Morto, e ao entrarem nas águas salgadas, estas se tornarão saudáveis.
verses.en_web: Then he said to me, “These waters flow out toward the eastern region, and will go down into the Arabah. Then they will go toward the sea; and flow into the sea which will be made to flow out; and the waters will be healed.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to me, These waters are flowing out to the east part of the land and down into the Arabah; and they will go to the sea, and the waters will be made sweet.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.
verses.pt: E por onde quer que entrar o rio viverá todo ser vivente que vive em enxames, e haverá muitíssimo peixe; porque lá chegarão estas águas, para que as águas do mar se tornem doces, e viverá tudo por onde quer que entrar este rio.
verses.en_web: It will happen, that every living creature which swarms, in every place where the rivers come, will live. Then there will be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters have come there, and the waters of the sea will be healed, and everything will live wherever the river comes.
verses.en_bbe: And it will come about that every living and moving thing, wherever their streams come, will have life; and there will be very much fish because these waters have come there and have been made sweet: and everything wherever the river comes will have life.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that the fishers shall stand upon it from En-gedi even unto En-eglaim; they shall be a place to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.
verses.pt: Os pescadores estarão junto dele; desde En-Gedi até En-Eglaim, haverá lugar para estender as redes; o seu peixe será, segundo a sua espécie, como o peixe do Mar Grande, em multidão excessiva.
verses.en_web: It will happen, that fishermen will stand by it. From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of nets. Their fish will be after their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceedingly many.
verses.en_bbe: And fishermen will take up their places by it: from En-gedi as far as En-eglaim will be a place for the stretching out of nets; the fish will be of every sort, like the fish of the Great Sea, a very great number.

verses.en: But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.
verses.pt: Mas os seus charcos e os seus pântanos não sararão; serão deixados para sal.
verses.en_web: But the miry places of it, and its marshes, will not be healed. They will be given up to salt.
verses.en_bbe: The wet places and the pools will not be made sweet; they will be given up to salt.

verses.en: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.
verses.pt: E junto do rio, à sua margem, de uma e de outra banda, nascerá toda sorte de árvore que dá fruto para se comer. Não murchará a sua folha, nem faltará o seu fruto. Nos seus meses produzirá novos frutos, porque as suas águas saem do santuário. O seu fruto servirá de alimento e a sua folha de remédio.
verses.en_web: By the river on its bank, on this side and on that side, will grow every tree for food, whose leaf won’t wither, neither will its fruit fail. It will produce new fruit every month, because its waters issue out of the sanctuary. Its fruit will be for food, and its leaf for healing.”
verses.en_bbe: And by the edge of the river, on this side and on that, will come up every tree used for food, whose leaves will ever be green and its fruit will not come to an end: it will have new fruit every month, because its waters come out from the holy place: the fruit will be for food and the leaf will make well those who are ill.

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This shall be the border, whereby ye shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph shall have two portions.
verses.pt: Assim diz o Senhor Deus: Este será o termo conforme o qual repartireis a terra em herança, segundo as doze tribos de Israel. José terá duas partes.
verses.en_web: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “This shall be the border, by which you shall divide the land for inheritance according to the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph shall have two portions.
verses.en_bbe: This is what the Lord has said: These are the limits by which you will take up your heritage in the land among the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph is to have two parts.

verses.en: And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another: concerning the which I lifted up mine hand to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.
verses.pt: E vós a herdareis, tanto um como o outro; pois sobre ela levantei a minha mão, jurando que a daria a vossos pais; assim esta terra vos cairá a vós em herança.
verses.en_web: You shall inherit it, one as well as another; for I swore to give it to your fathers. This land will fall to you for inheritance.
verses.en_bbe: And you are to make an equal division of it; as I gave my oath to your fathers to give it to you: for this land is to be your heritage.

verses.en: And this shall be the border of the land toward the north side, from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, as men go to Zedad;
verses.pt: E este será o termo da terra: da banda do norte, desde o Mar Grande, pelo caminho de Hetlom, até a entrada de Zedade;
verses.en_web: “This shall be the border of the land: “On the north side, from the great sea, by the way of Hethlon, to the entrance of Zedad;
verses.en_bbe: And this is to be the limit of the land: on the north side, from the Great Sea, in the direction of Hethlon, as far as the way into Hamath;

verses.en: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazar-hatticon, which is by the coast of Hauran.
verses.pt: Hamate, Berota, Sibraim, que está entre o termo de Damasco e o termo de Hamate; Hazer-Haticom, que está junto ao termo de Haurã.
verses.en_web: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazer Hatticon, which is by the border of Hauran.
verses.en_bbe: To Zedad, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the limit of Damascus and the limit of Hazar-hatticon, which is on the limit of Hauran.

verses.en: And the border from the sea shall be Hazar-enan, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath. And this is the north side.
verses.pt: O termo irá do mar até Hazar-Enom, junto ao termo setentrional de Damasco, tendo ao norte o termo de Hamate. Essa será a fronteira do norte.
verses.en_web: The border from the sea, shall be Hazar Enon at the border of Damascus; and on the north northward is the border of Hamath. This is the north side.
verses.en_bbe: And this is the limit from the sea in the direction of Hazar-enon; and the limit of Damascus is to the north, and on the north is the limit of Hamath. This is the north side.

verses.en: And the east side ye shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Israel by Jordan, from the border unto the east sea. And this is the east side.
verses.pt: E a fronteira do oriente, entre Haurã, e Damasco, e Gileade, e a terra de Israel, será o Jordão; desde o termo do norte até o mar do oriente medireis. Essa será a fronteira do oriente.
verses.en_web: “The east side, between Hauran and Damascus and Gilead, and the land of Israel, shall be the Jordan; from the north border to the east sea you shall measure. This is the east side.
verses.en_bbe: And the east side will be from Hazar-enon, which is between Hauran and Damascus; and between Gilead and the land of Israel the Jordan will be the limit, to the east sea, to Tamar. This is the east side.

verses.en: And the south side southward, from Tamar even to the waters of strife in Kadesh, the river to the great sea. And this is the south side southward.
verses.pt: E a fronteira meridional será desde Tamar até as águas de Meribote-Cades, ao longo do Ribeiro do Egito até o Mar Grande. Essa será a fronteira meridional.
verses.en_web: “The south side southward shall be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meriboth Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea. This is the south side southward.
verses.en_bbe: And the south side to the south will be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meribath-kadesh, to the stream of Egypt, to the Great Sea. This is the south side, on the south.

verses.en: The west side also shall be the great sea from the border, till a man come over against Hamath. This is the west side.
verses.pt: E a fronteira do ocidente será o Mar Grande, desde o termo do sul até a entrada de Hamate. Essa será a fronteira do ocidente.
verses.en_web: “The west side shall be the great sea, from the south border as far as over against the entrance of Hamath. This is the west side.
verses.en_bbe: And the west side will be the Great Sea, from the limit on the south to a point opposite the way into Hamath. This is the west side.

verses.en: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.
verses.pt: Repartireis, pois, esta terra entre vós, segundo as tribos de Israel.
verses.en_web: “So you shall divide this land to yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: You will make a division of the land among you, tribe by tribe.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you, and to the strangers that sojourn among you, which shall beget children among you: and they shall be unto you as born in the country among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
verses.pt: Reparti-la-eis em herança por sortes entre vós e entre os estrangeiros que habitam no meio de vós e que têm gerado filhos no meio de vós; e vós os tereis como naturais entre os filhos de Israel; convosco terão herança, no meio das tribos de Israel.
verses.en_web: It will happen, that you shall divide it by lot for an inheritance to you and to the aliens who live among you, who will father children among you. Then they shall be to you as the native-born among the children of Israel. They shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And you are to make a distribution of it, by the decision of the Lord, for a heritage to you and to the men from other lands who are living among you and who have children in your land: they will be the same to you as if they were Israelites by birth, they will have their heritage with you among the tribes of Israel.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give him his inheritance, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.pt: E será que na tribo em que peregrinar o estrangeiro, ali lhe dareis a sua herança, diz o Senhor Deus.
verses.en_web: It shall happen, that in whatever tribe the stranger lives, there you shall give him his inheritance,” says the Lord Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: In whatever tribe the man from a strange land is living, there you are to give him his heritage, says the Lord.
